postal_system.assignment_rule: The current UPU file updated August 2026 explicitly includes Côte d'Ivoire in its September 2025 list of countries not requiring postal codes. The UPU 09/2004 CI sheet labels 06 and 17 as two-digit post-office codes in BP address lines and 104 as the home-delivery indicator for office 04. These are office/routing components, not national postcodes.
postal_system.geometry_rule: No current CI postcode assignments exist to anchor postcode Polygon or MultiPolygon records. Country, district, region, department, sub-prefecture, commune, locality, post-office, BP, route, Point, administrative polygon, buffer, hull, Voronoi or raster cell, model output and AGID cell remain independently typed and must not be relabelled as postal geometry.
postal_system.address_rule: Keep recipient, organization, physical address or BP object, two-digit office code, locality and country separate. Do not add a fabricated postcode; repeated office codes around a BP remain part of the delivery address object.
postal_system.agid_rule: A source-qualified Abidjan result may display an independent CI AGID spatial ID, but that ID is not a postcode, office code, postal assignment, building identity or postal boundary.
postal_system.model_rule: Hugging Face, libpostal and other models may parse or rank source-qualified non-postal context only. They cannot create postal authority, assignments, geometry, rights or building identity.
postal_system.building_rule: Detailed place or building display requires its own rights-cleared civic-address identity and explicit reviewed relation to point or footprint geometry.
postal_system.licence_rule: UPU and ARTCI bodies are reference evidence. UPU copyright/database restrictions and ARTCI all-rights-reserved notice do not grant AGID postal dataset redistribution rights. OSM ODbL context remains a separate attributed partition.
postal_system.jurisdiction_rule: Preserve ISO CI and Côte d'Ivoire territory and aliases; do not merge with a neighbouring country or import its postcode assignments.
postal_system.temporal_rule: No-postcode status is time-dependent; retain retrieval time, edition, exact bytes and SHA-256 and re-check only after the pending-country sweep or a competent-authority announcement.

stages.definition: Legacy CI address metadata and synthetic planning-pack inventory.

Digest-bound UPU evidence that CI currently does not require postal codes, correction of the false five-digit metadata, and explicit office-code, BP, jurisdiction, rights, AGID, model and no-proxy contracts.

M2 requires a future current competent-authority CI postcode system and complete finite denominator of every assignment, office-code and BP distinction, alias, validity interval, correction, exception and explicit area/non-area object, fixed by retrieval time, edition, stable identity, schema, coverage, bytes and SHA-256 under rights compatible with AGID processing, storage, derivation, redistribution and public serving. Every drawable code must reconcile to fixed real Polygon/MultiPolygon geometry with postal authority, official/derived/virtual class, source, reference date, CRS, topology, method, confidence and exceptions. Country, district, region, department, sub-prefecture, commune, locality, address, office, BP, route, building, Point, buffer, hull, Voronoi/raster or AGID cell and model output are prohibited proxies. An approved immutable artifact must drive the real CI API/app through normalization, loading, no-match, multiple, failure, invalid geometry, map fit, translucent fill, clear outline, metadata, clear and re-search.

agid_integration.current_scope: CI no-postcode metadata, source-qualified address/place context and independent AGID spatial identity only; no CI Postal Context descriptor is enabled.
agid_integration.enablement_gate: A future authoritative postcode release, compatible rights, immutable assignments and exact postal Polygon/MultiPolygon artifacts must pass CI quality and real API/app verification.
agid_integration.geometry_rule: Do not manufacture a CI postal polygon. Independently licensed address, building or administrative context stays separate and source-qualified.
